name: dev.mcpharbor.gateway/pubchem
title: PubChem
description: PubChem chemistry: compound properties, molecule structures, SMILES, safety, bioassays

compliance.attribution: Attribution to source recommended, not mandatory
compliance.notes: 5 requests/second and 400/minute, dynamically throttled under load.
compliance.reasoning: PubChem is an NIH/NCBI public resource provided free of charge with no restriction on use or distribution of the aggregated data, matching a commercial-proxy pattern; NCBI's general policy only asks that redistributors of any copyrighted third-party-submitted records (e.g. certain vendor safety data) respect the original submitter's terms. Compliance requires observing the documented 5 req/s dynamic throttling limits.

evidence.quote: All PubChem data, tools, and services ... are provided to the public free of charge
NCBI itself places no restrictions on the use or distribution of the data
some submitters of the original data ... may claim patent, copyright
